January.powerDesc: A strength forged in the silence of the highest peaks, patient enough to outlast any storm and remember what the mountain has forgotten.
January.guide: The Mountain Sage of the North
January.lore: Born from the first snowfall of the universe, the Elder Frost Dragon watches over the passage of time from a throne of glacial silence. Those born in January share its resilience and its rare gift for seeing through the illusions of the present into the plain truths of the past. Where others rush, the Dragon waits, knowing that ice reshapes mountains given enough centuries.

February.powerDesc: Carried on currents no one else can feel, the Storm Griffin sees tomorrow before it arrives, circling far above the arguments of the present.
February.lore: Legends place the Storm Griffin at the edge of every great change, wings cutting through the static before a new age is born. February-born souls inherit its refusal to be caged by convention; they would rather be strange and right than ordinary and safe. The Griffin does not flock — it charts new sky.

March.powerDesc: Drawn from waters no light has ever touched, the Moonlit Kraken shapes dreams the waking world forgets by morning, threading them back into the tide.
March.lore: Where the ocean floor drops beyond any chart, the Moonlit Kraken keeps the archive of every dream ever surrendered to sleep. Those born in March carry a piece of that archive with them — a permeable border between what is real and what is only felt, deeply, as if it were.

April.powerDesc: The spark that starts what others hesitate to begin, the Flamehorn Ram burns brightest at the very first charge, never the last.
April.lore: The Flamehorn Ram is said to have lit the very first sunrise by charging headlong at the dark. April-born souls carry that same reckless courage — the kind that leaps before it looks, and somehow, more often than not, lands standing.

May.powerDesc: Rooted deeper than any maze can reach, the Emerald Minotaur becomes immovable once a promise is made — a will that outlasts the labyrinth itself.
May.lore: Deep in the oldest labyrinth, the Emerald Minotaur guards not a monster's secret but a garden — proof that strength and gentleness were never opposites. May-born souls are known for loyalty that does not waver and for finding beauty in the slow, patient work others abandon too soon.

June.powerDesc: Speaking two truths in a single breath, the Twin-Tailed Sylph is at home in every changing wind, never quite landing, never quite lost.
June.lore: The Twin-Tailed Sylph is said to have been born of a single breath split into two winds, each pursuing a different horizon and neither wrong. June-born souls carry that same restless duality — equally at home in conversation and in solitude, in logic and in wonder.

July.powerDesc: Guarding what the tide brings home, the Pearl Serpent stays gentle until something threatens the nest — and then becomes something else entirely.
July.lore: Coiled around the last shell of a sunken temple, the Pearl Serpent has guarded the same shoreline since the moon was new. July-born souls inherit a fierce, quiet devotion — they build homes out of people, and will defend them without needing to be asked twice.

August.powerDesc: Rising brighter from every ending, the Phoenix is unwilling to stay buried in any kind of ash, no matter how deep it is pressed down.
August.lore: No creature in the twelve orders has died and returned more times than the Phoenix, and none wears its scars as ornaments quite so proudly. August-born souls carry a natural warmth that draws others close, and a resilience that turns every collapse into the opening act of a comeback.

September.powerDesc: Seen by eyes that miss nothing, the Whispering Sphinx answers riddles with riddles of its own, trusting only those patient enough to earn the truth.
September.lore: The Whispering Sphinx has guarded the same threshold since before roads led anywhere, testing every traveler with a question shaped exactly to their blind spot. September-born souls share that exacting eye — quick to notice what's out of place, slower, and far more careful, to hand out their trust.

October.powerDesc: Holding two worlds in one form, the Twilight Chimera lets neither dusk nor dawn claim it fully — a living argument for the beauty of the in-between.
October.lore: The Twilight Chimera was formed at the exact hour the sky can't decide between gold and violet, and has kept that indecision as its gift ever since. October-born souls are natural peacemakers, drawn instinctively to fairness, and quietly exhausted by anyone who insists the world is only one thing.

November.powerDesc: A single drop that changes everything, the Shadow Basilisk guards a door the underworld left open, daring the curious to knock.
November.lore: Few who meet the gaze of the Shadow Basilisk leave unchanged; fewer still leave unwilling to. November-born souls carry that same transformative intensity — allergic to small talk, drawn to what's real underneath, and utterly unafraid of the dark places most people avoid.

December.powerDesc: Chasing horizons no map has ever drawn, the Starforged Wyvern stays restless beneath an endless night sky, forever one flight from home.
December.lore: The Starforged Wyvern was hatched from a star that refused to stay fixed in its constellation, and has been wandering ever since, forging new paths from scattered light. December-born souls share its appetite for the horizon — optimistic, blunt, and happiest when there's somewhere new to be.
